events.headline: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow
events.summary: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering and applied to list on Nasdaq under ANT; the offering had not yet become effective.

events.headline: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 launch
events.summary: Anthropic released upgraded models for demanding technical work, with improvements in coding, reasoning and vision, plus an optional fast mode.

events.headline: Personal Finance in Claude enters beta
events.summary: Anthropic began rolling out read-only bank-account connections and personal-finance analysis to US Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers.

events.headline: Claude Enterprise adds security and administration controls
events.summary: New capabilities include a security center, inference hooks, centralized management, IP allowlists and controls for signing members out.

events.headline: Claude Marketplace expands its partner-product catalog
events.summary: Anthropic added agents and products spanning security, developer infrastructure, creative work and productivity to Claude Marketplace.

events.headline: Message threads enters public beta
events.summary: The Messages API can retain conversation history between requests, letting agents send only new messages to reduce latency.

events.headline: Claude Code product lead Cat Wu leaves Anthropic
events.summary: Wu subsequently disclosed that her last day was October 30, 2026; Anthropic confirmed her departure, and she later announced a move to OpenAI.

events.headline: Usage and Cost Analytics API launches in beta
events.summary: Anthropic introduced unified usage and cost analytics endpoints for Claude Console and Claude Enterprise organizations.

events.headline: Enterprise reports, surveys and pooled budgets become generally available
events.summary: Claude Enterprise made smart reports, in-app surveys and shared team budgets generally available.

events.headline: Claude for Legal adds ready-to-use artifacts
events.summary: Anthropic introduced adaptable legal tools for contract review, regulatory tracking and matter management, alongside a Legal Ambassadors Program.

events.headline: Claude for Financial Advisors launches
events.summary: A new suite of connectors and workflow skills supports advisor research, meeting preparation, portfolio analysis and documentation.

events.headline: Government purchasing agreement expands across products and jurisdictions
events.summary: As of 2026-10-27, a new GSA agreement offered a 40% discount across Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the API, extending to state, local, tribal and territorial governments.

events.headline: Anthropic publicly files for proposed IPO
events.summary: Anthropic filed a registration statement with the SEC for a proposed public offering of Class A common stock, intending to list on Nasdaq as ANT.

events.headline: Claude for Nonprofits plugin launches
events.summary: The new plugin supplies skills and connectors for nonprofit fundraising, marketing, hiring and operational work.

events.headline: Unified Claude chat and Cowork reaches Enterprise
events.summary: The combined chat-and-agent experience became generally available for Enterprise across web, desktop and mobile, with role-based access and Efficient mode.

events.headline: Anthropic-managed Claude API launches on Google Cloud
events.summary: Anthropic introduced its directly operated Claude API through Google Cloud projects, using Google Cloud identity controls and Marketplace billing.

events.headline: Claude Duet opens in research preview
events.summary: Anthropic introduced a proactive-agent app that monitors connected services, prepares work and requests approval before consequential actions, initially through a US subscriber waitlist.

events.headline: Anthropic releases a new API version and major SDK updates
events.summary: The platform released a new API version alongside breaking SDK and command-line updates, with the updated clients switching to Apache licensing.

events.headline: Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
events.summary: The experimental physicist and former Harvard Dean of Science joined the trust that helps oversee Anthropic's public-benefit mission.

events.headline: Opus 5.5 fast mode exits research preview
events.summary: Fast mode became available without requesting access or supplying a beta header, and expanded to Microsoft Foundry deployments hosted on Azure.

events.headline: Anthropic opens Singapore office
events.summary: Anthropic opened a Singapore office and signed a government memorandum covering AI safety, evaluation, adoption research and responsible deployment.

events.headline: Claude Dashboards and Motion launch in beta
events.summary: Anthropic introduced live dashboards and animated explainers, while making Docs, Slides and Design generally available across all plans, including Free.

events.headline: Anthropic Cyber Mission launches with new defensive offerings
events.summary: Anthropic introduced the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program and free recurring OSS Scanner security scans for participating open-source projects.

events.headline: Claude Haiku 5.5 launches
events.summary: Anthropic released a small model designed for high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks, including summarization, coding subagents and browser use.

events.headline: Sonnet cache-read pricing falls and subscriptions gain API credits
events.summary: As of 2026-10-07, Sonnet 5.5 cache reads fell from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens; Anthropic also announced monthly API credits for eligible subscribers.

events.headline: Cyber Verification Program expands
events.summary: Anthropic introduced tiered access to advanced models and reduced blocking classifiers for qualifying security professionals.

events.headline: Claude Frontier Academy launches
events.summary: As of 2026-10-02, Anthropic committed $100 million to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027, beginning with customer and partner cohorts.

events.headline: Claude for Government becomes generally available
events.summary: The FedRAMP High-authorized service became generally available to federal and state agencies, with Claude Code CLI and Microsoft 365 integration entering early access.

events.headline: Claude Sonnet 5.5 launches
events.summary: Anthropic released an upgraded Sonnet model positioned for everyday work, coding fixes and document creation, with improved speed and task efficiency.

events.headline: Claude plugin developer portal opens
events.summary: Developers gained a portal to submit plugins to Claude's directory, track review status and inspect usage analytics.

events.headline: Claude Opus 5.5 launches
events.summary: Anthropic released the first model in its Claude 5.5 family, emphasizing stronger coding, knowledge-work performance and alignment testing.

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
